description: Who may produce a dev-platform release: the release workflow of this repository, run on a GitHub-hosted runner for a protected version tag. A valid signature is necessary but not sufficient: the signer identity must match this policy. A release that passes every check is `verified` (a `-alpha/-beta/-rc` version is `pre-release`); the authority to release is the permission to push a protected version tag, with no separate approval record (ADR 0024). Release N must carry a continuity record: the named predecessor, digest-pinned here, re-ran the full stage over N's source (evidence, never authority).
